```{r}
# Function to create a horizontal or vertical eye legend - Version 8
# Improved implementation with better geometry control and consistent orientation handling
f.eye_legend_horiz_to_vert_v8 <- function(
  # Basic dimensions with dynamic orientation handling
  long_side_dimension = 800,   # Longer side of the plot
  short_side_dimension = 100,  # Shorter side of the plot
  is_vertical = FALSE,         # Control orientation
  
  # Spacing parameters
  left_margin = 40,            # Space at left/bottom edge (depending on orientation)
  right_margin = 40,           # Space at right/top edge (depending on orientation)
  icon_text_gap = 20,          # Space between icon and its text
  element_gap = 60,            # Space between text and next icon
  
  # Flexible spacing ratios
  margin_ratio = NULL,         # Optional ratio-based margin calculation
  inter_element_ratio = NULL,  # Optional ratio-based element spacing
  
  # Sizing parameters
  text_size = 10,              # Base text size
  circle_size = 20,            # Radius of the station circle
  aletta_scale = 2.5,          # Scale factor for Aletta symbol
  bud_scale = 0.18,            # Scale factor for Bud hurricane image
  icon_scale_factor = 1,       # Global scaling for all icons
  
  # Circle styling parameters
  circle_parameters = NULL,    # Circle styling parameters
  orange_circle_dash_length = "dashed", # Parameter to control dash spacing
  
  # Debug options
  debug_grid = FALSE           # Add debug grid to visualize layout
) {
  # Helper function for null values
  "%||%" <- function(x, y) {
    if (is.null(x)) y else x
  }
  
  # Dynamically set plot dimensions based on orientation
  if (is_vertical) {
    plot_width <- short_side_dimension
    plot_height <- long_side_dimension
  } else {
    plot_width <- long_side_dimension
    plot_height <- short_side_dimension
  }
  
  # Calculate margins using ratio if provided
  if (!is.null(margin_ratio)) {
    total_margin_width <- plot_width * margin_ratio
    left_margin <- total_margin_width / 2
    right_margin <- total_margin_width / 2
  }
  
  # Calculate element gap using ratio if provided
  if (!is.null(inter_element_ratio)) {
    if (is_vertical) {
      element_gap <- plot_height * inter_element_ratio
    } else {
      element_gap <- plot_width * inter_element_ratio
    }
  }
  
  # Adjust scaling for icons
  adjusted_circle_size <- circle_size * icon_scale_factor
  adjusted_aletta_scale <- aletta_scale * icon_scale_factor
  adjusted_bud_scale <- bud_scale * icon_scale_factor
  
  # Extract styling from circle_parameters
  if (!is.null(circle_parameters)) {
    circle_color1 <- circle_parameters["circle_color1"] %||% "white"
    circle_color2 <- circle_parameters["circle_color2"] %||% "#E65832"
    base <- as.numeric(circle_parameters["base"] %||% "5.0")
    outline <- as.numeric(circle_parameters["outline"] %||% "7.5")
    line1 <- circle_parameters["line1"] %||% "solid"
    line2 <- circle_parameters["line2"] %||% "dashed"
    hurricane_image_path <- circle_parameters["hurricane_image_path"] %||% NULL
  } else {
    # Default values if circle_parameters is NULL
    circle_color1 <- "white"
    circle_color2 <- "#E65832"
    base <- 5.0
    outline <- 7.5
    line1 <- "solid"
    line2 <- orange_circle_dash_length
    hurricane_image_path <- NULL
  }
  
  # Set line thicknesses for legend
  legend_outline <- outline * 0.5
  legend_base <- base * 0.5
  
  # Text labels
  text1 <- "TC Bud Eye"
  text2 <- "TC Aletta Eye"
  text3 <- "200km Diameter\nStation 3.5"
  
  # Calculate positions for elements
  if (is_vertical) {
    # For vertical layout, we will stack elements from top to bottom
    # with consistent spacing
    
    # Element positions (vertical layout)
    y_start <- plot_height - left_margin
    
    # Bud hurricane and text
    y_bud <- y_start
    y_bud_text <- y_bud - icon_text_gap
    
    # Aletta symbol and text
    y_aletta <- y_bud_text - element_gap
    y_aletta_text <- y_aletta - icon_text_gap
    
    # Station circle and text
    y_station <- y_aletta_text - element_gap
    y_station_text <- y_station - icon_text_gap
    
    # Center all elements horizontally
    x_center <- plot_width / 2
    
    # For circle coordinates
    circle_points <- data.frame(
      x = x_center + adjusted_circle_size * cos(seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 100)),
      y = y_station + adjusted_circle_size * sin(seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 100))
    )
  } else {
    # For horizontal layout, we will arrange elements from left to right
    # with consistent spacing
    
    # Element positions (horizontal layout)
    x_start <- left_margin
    
    # Bud hurricane and text
    x_bud <- x_start
    x_bud_text <- x_bud + icon_text_gap
    
    # Aletta symbol and text
    x_aletta <- x_bud_text + element_gap
    x_aletta_text <- x_aletta + icon_text_gap
    
    # Station circle and text
    x_station <- x_aletta_text + element_gap
    x_station_text <- x_station + icon_text_gap
    
    # Center all elements vertically
    y_center <- plot_height / 2
    
    # For circle coordinates
    circle_points <- data.frame(
      x = x_station + adjusted_circle_size * cos(seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 100)),
      y = y_center + adjusted_circle_size * sin(seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 100))
    )
  }
  
  # Create base plot with proper dimensions
  p <- ggplot() +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA)
    )
  
  # Add debug grid if requested
  if (debug_grid) {
    grid_x <- seq(0, plot_width, length.out = 11)
    grid_y <- seq(0, plot_height, length.out = 11)
    
    p <- p + 
      geom_vline(xintercept = grid_x, color = "lightblue", linetype = "dotted") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = grid_y, color = "lightpink", linetype = "dotted") +
      annotate("text", x = grid_x, y = rep(10, length(grid_x)), 
               label = paste0(round(grid_x)), size = 2, color = "blue") +
      annotate("text", x = rep(10, length(grid_y)), y = grid_y, 
               label = paste0(round(grid_y)), size = 2, color = "red")
  }
  
  # Add elements to the plot based on orientation
  if (is_vertical) {
    # Station circle (white solid outline)
    p <- p + geom_path(
      data = circle_points,
      aes(x, y),
      color = circle_color1,
      linewidth = legend_outline,
      linetype = line1,
      alpha = 1,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    )
    
    # Station circle (orange dashed)
    p <- p + geom_path(
      data = circle_points,
      aes(x, y),
      color = circle_color2,
      linewidth = legend_base,
      linetype = line2,
      alpha = 1,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    )
    
    # Aletta eye symbol
    p <- p + geom_point(
      data = data.frame(x = x_center, y = y_aletta),
      aes(x, y),
      shape = 25,  # Default triangle shape if not defined externally
      color = "black",  # Default color if not defined externally
      fill = "black",   # Default fill if not defined externally
      size = adjusted_aletta_scale,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    )
    
    # Bud eye image (hurricane)
    if (!is.null(hurricane_image_path)) {
      p <- p + geom_image(
        data = data.frame(x = x_center, y = y_bud, image = hurricane_image_path),
        aes(x, y, image = image),
        size = adjusted_bud_scale,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      # Placeholder if no image provided
      p <- p + annotate(
        "text", x = x_center, y = y_bud,
        label = "H", size = adjusted_bud_scale * 10, fontface = "bold"
      )
    }
    
    # Text labels with rotation for vertical layout
    p <- p + 
      annotate("text", x = x_center, y = y_bud_text, label = text1, 
               angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = text_size/2.5) +
      annotate("text", x = x_center, y = y_aletta_text, label = text2, 
               angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = text_size/2.5) +
      annotate("text", x = x_center, y = y_station_text, label = text3, 
               angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = text_size/2.5)
  } else {
    # Station circle (white solid outline)
    p <- p + geom_path(
      data = circle_points,
      aes(x, y),
      color = circle_color1,
      linewidth = legend_outline,
      linetype = line1,
      alpha = 1,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    )
    
    # Station circle (orange dashed)
    p <- p + geom_path(
      data = circle_points,
      aes(x, y),
      color = circle_color2,
      linewidth = legend_base,
      linetype = line2,
      alpha = 1,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    )
    
    # Aletta eye symbol
    p <- p + geom_point(
      data = data.frame(x = x_aletta, y = y_center),
      aes(x, y),
      shape = 25,  # Default triangle shape if not defined externally
      color = "black",  # Default color if not defined externally
      fill = "black",   # Default fill if not defined externally
      size = adjusted_aletta_scale,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    )
    
    # Bud eye image (hurricane)
    if (!is.null(hurricane_image_path)) {
      p <- p + geom_image(
        data = data.frame(x = x_bud, y = y_center, image = hurricane_image_path),
        aes(x, y, image = image),
        size = adjusted_bud_scale,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      # Placeholder if no image provided
      p <- p + annotate(
        "text", x = x_bud, y = y_center,
        label = "H", size = adjusted_bud_scale * 10, fontface = "bold"
      )
    }
    
    # Text labels for horizontal layout
    p <- p + 
      annotate("text", x = x_bud_text, y = y_center, label = text1, 
               hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = text_size/2.5) +
      annotate("text", x = x_aletta_text, y = y_center, label = text2, 
               hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = text_size/2.5) +
      annotate("text", x = x_station_text, y = y_center, label = text3, 
               hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = text_size/2.5)
  }
  
  # Ensure plot dimensions are fixed and proper
  p <- p + coord_fixed(
    xlim = c(0, plot_width),
    ylim = c(0, plot_height),
    expand = FALSE
  )
  
  return(p)
}
```

v9
```{r}
# Function to create a horizontal or vertical eye legend - Version 9
# Improved implementation with better proportions and spacing based on original approach
f.eye_legend_horiz_to_vert_v9 <- function(
  # Basic layout parameters similar to original approach
  offset_1 = 0.06,           # Offset for first element (proportion of plot_width)
  x_space = 80,              # Base spacing unit for elements
  plot_x = 3014,             # Total plot width
  plot_y = 252,              # Total plot height
  
  # Display parameters
  text_size = 6,             # Text size (original used 6)
  is_vertical = FALSE,       # Control orientation
  
  # Circle styling parameters
  circle_parameters = NULL,  # Circle styling parameters
  
  # Debug options
  debug_grid = FALSE         # Add debug grid to visualize layout
) {
  # Helper function for null values
  "%||%" <- function(x, y) {
    if (is.null(x)) y else x
  }
  
  # Determine basic dimensions
  if (is_vertical) {
    # For vertical orientation, swap dimensions
    temp <- plot_x
    plot_x <- plot_y
    plot_y <- temp
  }
  
  # Calculate positions using original approach
  x1 <- round((offset_1 * plot_x), 1)  # First element x position
  x_equal <- (plot_x - x1) / 3         # Equal spacing for remaining elements
  
  # Horizontal element positions
  x2 <- x1 + x_space                   # Bud text position
  x3 <- x1 + x_equal                   # Aletta icon position
  x4 <- x3 + x_space                   # Aletta text position
  x5 <- x3 + x_equal                   # Station circle position
  x6 <- x5 + (x_space * 3)             # Station text position
  
  # Vertical center
  y1 <- plot_y / 2
  
  # Extract styling from circle_parameters
  if (!is.null(circle_parameters)) {
    circle_color1 <- circle_parameters["circle_color1"] %||% "white"
    circle_color2 <- circle_parameters["circle_color2"] %||% "#E65832"
    base <- as.numeric(circle_parameters["base"] %||% "5.0")
    outline <- as.numeric(circle_parameters["outline"] %||% "7.5")
    line1 <- circle_parameters["line1"] %||% "solid"
    line2 <- circle_parameters["line2"] %||% "dashed"
    hurricane_image_path <- circle_parameters["hurricane_image_path"] %||% NULL
    aletta_symbol <- as.numeric(circle_parameters["aletta_symbol"] %||% "25")
    aletta_color <- circle_parameters["aletta_color"] %||% "black"
    aletta_size <- as.numeric(circle_parameters["aletta_size"] %||% "2.5")
  } else {
    # Default values if circle_parameters is NULL
    circle_color1 <- "white"
    circle_color2 <- "#E65832"
    base <- 5.0
    outline <- 7.5
    line1 <- "solid"
    line2 <- "dashed"
    hurricane_image_path <- NULL
    aletta_symbol <- 25  # Triangle symbol
    aletta_color <- "black"
    aletta_size <- 2.5
  }
  
  # Set line thicknesses for legend
  legend_outline <- outline * 0.5
  legend_base <- base * 0.5
  
  # Text labels
  text1 <- "TC Bud Eye"
  text2 <- "TC Aletta Eye"
  text3 <- "200km Diameter\nStation 3.5"
  
  # Create circle points data - use x_space as the circle size like in original
  circle_size <- x_space / 4  # Adjusted for better proportions compared to original
  
  # Create data for images and points
  if (is_vertical) {
    # Vertical orientation - transform coordinates
    # For a clean 90-degree rotation:
    # - New x = original y
    # - New y = plot height - original x
    bud_data <- data.frame(x = y1, y = plot_y - x1, image = hurricane_image_path)
    aletta_data <- data.frame(x = y1, y = plot_y - x3)
    
    # For circle coordinates - rotate points
    circle_points <- data.frame(
      x = y1 + circle_size * cos(seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 100)),
      y = plot_y - x5 + circle_size * sin(seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 100))
    )
    
    # Text positions
    bud_text_x <- y1
    bud_text_y <- plot_y - x2
    
    aletta_text_x <- y1
    aletta_text_y <- plot_y - x4
    
    station_text_x <- y1
    station_text_y <- plot_y - x6
    
    # Text angles
    text_angle <- 90
    text_hjust <- 1
  } else {
    # Horizontal orientation - use original coordinates
    bud_data <- data.frame(x = x1, y = y1, image = hurricane_image_path)
    aletta_data <- data.frame(x = x3, y = y1)
    
    # For circle coordinates
    circle_points <- data.frame(
      x = x5 + circle_size * cos(seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 100)),
      y = y1 + circle_size * sin(seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 100))
    )
    
    # Text positions
    bud_text_x <- x2
    bud_text_y <- y1
    
    aletta_text_x <- x4
    aletta_text_y <- y1
    
    station_text_x <- x6
    station_text_y <- y1
    
    # Text angles
    text_angle <- 0
    text_hjust <- 0
  }
  
  # Create base plot with proper dimensions
  p <- ggplot() +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA)
    )
  
  # Add debug grid if requested
  if (debug_grid) {
    grid_x <- seq(0, plot_x, length.out = 21)
    grid_y <- seq(0, plot_y, length.out = 11)
    
    p <- p + 
      geom_vline(xintercept = grid_x, color = "lightblue", linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = grid_y, color = "lightpink", linetype = "dotted", alpha = 0.5) +
      # Add key position markers
      annotate("point", x = c(x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6), y = rep(10, 6), 
               color = "blue", size = 3, alpha = 0.5) +
      annotate("text", x = c(x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6), y = rep(20, 6), 
               label = c("x1", "x2", "x3", "x4", "x5", "x6"), 
               size = 3, color = "blue", angle = 0)
  }
  
  # Station circle (white solid outline)
  p <- p + geom_path(
    data = circle_points,
    aes(x, y),
    color = circle_color1,
    linewidth = legend_outline,
    linetype = line1,
    alpha = 1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )
  
  # Station circle (orange dashed)
  p <- p + geom_path(
    data = circle_points,
    aes(x, y),
    color = circle_color2,
    linewidth = legend_base,
    linetype = line2,
    alpha = 1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )
  
  # Aletta eye symbol
  p <- p + geom_point(
    data = aletta_data,
    aes(x, y),
    shape = aletta_symbol,
    color = aletta_color,
    fill = aletta_color,
    size = aletta_size,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )
  
  # Bud eye image (hurricane)
  if (!is.null(hurricane_image_path)) {
    p <- p + geom_image(
      data = bud_data,
      aes(x, y, image = image),
      size = 0.15,  # Adjusted size for better proportions
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    # Placeholder if no image provided
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text", x = bud_data$x, y = bud_data$y,
      label = "H", size = 10, fontface = "bold"
    )
  }
  
  # Add text labels
  p <- p + 
    annotate("text", x = bud_text_x, y = bud_text_y, 
             label = text1, angle = text_angle, hjust = text_hjust, 
             vjust = 0.5, size = text_size) +
    annotate("text", x = aletta_text_x, y = aletta_text_y, 
             label = text2, angle = text_angle, hjust = text_hjust, 
             vjust = 0.5, size = text_size) +
    annotate("text", x = station_text_x, y = station_text_y, 
             label = text3, angle = text_angle, hjust = text_hjust, 
             vjust = 0.5, size = text_size)
  
  # Ensure plot dimensions are fixed and proper
  p <- p + coord_fixed(
    xlim = c(0, plot_x),
    ylim = c(0, plot_y),
    expand = FALSE
  )
  
  return(p)
}
```
